name: Auto Completer
description: Pathfinding bot that beats levels for you, with play styles, a path viewer and a Mega Hack style menu.

enabled.name: Enable Auto Completer
enabled.description: Plan a safe route through every level you open and play it automatically. Safe mode is always on while the bot is active: no progress, stars or leaderboard submissions are saved.

play-style.name: Play Style
play-style.description:
<cy>Default</c>: balanced, clicks in the middle of each safe timing window.
<cg>Perfect</c>: frame precise scan with the widest margins, slower to plan.
<cb>Human</c>: natural timing spread and tap lengths.
<co>Minimal</c>: latest safe click, shortest taps.

ignore-inputs.name: Ignore Inputs
ignore-inputs.description: Block your own clicks while the bot is playing.

auto-correct.name: Auto Correct
auto-correct.description: If the real run drifts away from the planned path, plan again from that point.

compute-budget.name: Compute Budget (ms per frame)
compute-budget.description: How long the planner may run each frame while computing a path. Higher values plan faster.

path-viewer.name: Show Path
path-viewer.description: Draw the planned route inside the level.

path-full.name: Show Whole Path
path-full.description: Draw the full route instead of only the part ahead of the player.

path-clicks.name: Click Markers
path-clicks.description: Yellow dots where clicks start, red dots where they end.

path-lookahead.name: Lookahead (seconds)
path-lookahead.description: How far ahead of the player the route is drawn.

menu-key.name: Menu Key
menu-key.description: Opens and closes the Auto Completer menu.

show-hud.name: Status HUD
show-hud.description: Show a small status line in the corner while in a level.
